results.review_reason: Springer confirms a real DOI and detailed survey/PLS-SEM article on managers in Philippine B2B firms. No verified formal correction or publisher clarification resolves this conflict. Do not accept as fully validated empirical evidence yet. Study can be re-evaluated upon a publisher erratum/author clarification and access to instrument/respondent/sampling provenance; absence of data transparency alone does not prove flawed results.
